ObjectStates.Name: Bag
ObjectStates.LuaScript:
--[[ Sisters Auto-Assign (script of the "Sisters" bag)

Load an army in the Yellow Machine (paste code -> Submit -> Accept), then press AUTO on this bag
(or right-click the bag -> "Auto-assign army"). Every model card gets models from this bag; check
the cards and press CREATE ARMY as usual. Matching rules: BAG_RULES.md, reference implementation:
tools/check_bag.py (keep both in sync).

How it plugs into Yellowscribe: assigning a model there only stores the picked object's data in
army[unit].models.models[model].associatedModels plus associatedModelBounds. The ForceOrg copy keeps
`army` local, and TTS forbids mixing tables of two scripts anyway, so the first AUTO adds two small
functions (HOOK_CODE) to the Yellow Machine script and reloads it. They exchange JSON strings only:
sistersAutoGetArmy returns what matching needs, sistersAutoAssign writes the chosen models in.

Model sizes: Yellowscribe lays units out by each model's bounds, which only a spawned object can
tell. "Index new models" (bag context menu) spawns every model not measured yet, measures it and
keeps the result in this bag's script state, keyed by the model's meshes (modelSignature), so a
saved and shared bag never measures again. AUTO itself never waits: models not indexed yet use the
base size from the roster.
]]

local YELLOW_MACHINE_GUID = "46ccee" -- also hard-coded in Yellowscribe's own UI XML
local HOOK_ANCHOR = "local yellowStorage,YELLOW_STORAGE_XML,YELLOW_STORAGE_SCRIPT,army" -- ForceOrg's local
local HOOK_BEGIN = "-- [Sisters Auto-Assign hook v2]"
local HOOK_END = "-- [/Sisters Auto-Assign hook]"
local HOOK_CODE = "\n" .. HOOK_BEGIN .. [[ lets the Sisters bag read and fill the loaded army
function sistersAutoGetArmy()
    if army == nil then return nil end
    local units = {}
    for unitID, unit in pairs(army) do
        local models = {}
        for modelID, m in pairs(unit.models.models) do
            local weapons = {}
            for _, w in ipairs(m.weapons or {}) do table.insert(weapons, w.name) end
            table.insert(models, { id = modelID, name = m.name, weapons = weapons, base = m.base,
                manual = m.associatedModels ~= nil and #m.associatedModels > 0 and not m.autoAssigned })
        end
        table.insert(units, { id = unitID, name = unit.name, models = models })
    end
    return JSON.encode(units)
end
function sistersAutoAssign(params)
    for _, a in ipairs(JSON.decode(params.json)) do
        local m = army[a.unit].models.models[a.model]
        m.associatedModels, m.associatedModelBounds = a.models, a.bounds
        m.autoAssigned = a.models ~= nil or nil
    end
end
]] .. HOOK_END .. "\n"
-- hooks of earlier versions, removed before the current one is added
local OLD_HOOKS = {
    "\n-- [Sisters Auto-Assign hook] lets the Sisters bag read and fill the loaded army\n"
        .. "function sistersAutoGetArmy() return army end\n"
        .. "function sistersAutoSetArmy(params) army = params.army end\n",
}
local CARD_COLORS = { exact = "#24d11e", fallback = "#f5a623", approx = "#e8590c", none = "#dbdee0" }
local RANK = { exact = 3, fallback = 2, approx = 1, none = 0 }
local STANDARD_GEAR = { ["bolt pistol"] = true, ["close combat weapon"] = true }
local MEASURE_HEIGHT = 25 -- temporary copies for measuring are spawned this far above the bag
local INDEX_BATCH = 10    -- models measured at the same time
local INDEX_TIMEOUT = 15  -- seconds to wait for one model to load

local RED, ORANGE, GREEN, GREY = { 1, 0.35, 0.35 }, { 1, 0.65, 0.15 }, { 0.3, 0.9, 0.3 }, { 0.8, 0.8, 0.8 }

local boundsCache = {} -- modelSignature -> bounds, saved with the bag (onSave)
local busy = false


--[[ TEXT NORMALISATION (same rules as tools/check_bag.py) ]]--

local function trim(s)
    return (s:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""))
end

local function normWeapon(s)
    s = s:lower():gsub("➤", ""):gsub("’", "'")
    s = trim(s)
    s = s:gsub("^%d+x%s+", "")      -- "3x Heavy bolter"
    s = s:gsub("%s+%-%s+.*$", "")   -- "Plasma pistol - supercharge"
    s = s:gsub("%s*%(.*%)%s*$", "") -- "Blessed Halberd (Through Suffering, Strength)"
    s = s:gsub("%-", " "):gsub("%s+", " ")
    return trim(s)
end

local function normName(s)
    s = s:lower():gsub("’", "'"):gsub("%-", " "):gsub("%s+", " ")
    return trim(s)
end

local function startsWith(s, prefix)
    return s:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix
end

-- bag name "battle sister" fits "battle sister w/ special weapon", but not "battle sister superior"
local function familyMatches(bagName, rosterName)
    return startsWith(rosterName, bagName .. " w/")
        or startsWith(rosterName, bagName .. " with ")
        or startsWith(rosterName, bagName .. " (")
end


--[[ MODEL SIGNATURE ]]--

local function partSignature(data)
    local mesh, bundle, t = data.CustomMesh or {}, data.CustomAssetbundle or {}, data.Transform or {}
    return table.concat({
        data.Name or "",
        mesh.MeshURL or bundle.AssetbundleURL or "",
        mesh.ColliderURL or "",
        string.format("%.2f,%.2f,%.2f", t.scaleX or 1, t.scaleY or 1, t.scaleZ or 1),
    }, "|")
end

-- Same meshes, colliders and scale = same size, whichever bag or GUID the model has.
-- Attached parts (bases) count too; their positions are stored relative to the model.
local function modelSignature(data)
    local parts = { partSignature(data) }
    for _, child in ipairs(data.ChildObjects or {}) do
        local t = child.Transform or {}
        table.insert(parts, partSignature(child)
            .. string.format("@%.2f,%.2f,%.2f", t.posX or 0, t.posY or 0, t.posZ or 0))
    end
    return table.concat(parts, ";")
end


--[[ BAG ]]--

local function loadLibrary()
    local library = {}

    for _, data in ipairs(self.getData().ContainedObjects or {}) do
        local model = {
            data = data,
            key = modelSignature(data),
            name = trim(data.Nickname or ""),
            names = {},
            tokens = {},
            fallback = false,
        }
        table.insert(model.names, normName(model.name))

        for line in ((data.Description or "") .. "\n"):gmatch("([^\n]*)\n") do
            line = trim(line)
            local low = line:lower()

            if line == "" or line:sub(1, 1) == "#" then
                -- comment
            elseif low == "fallback" then
                model.fallback = true
            elseif startsWith(low, "alias:") then
                table.insert(model.names, normName(line:sub(7)))
            elseif startsWith(low, "unit:") then
                model.unit = normName(line:sub(6))
            elseif startsWith(low, "variant:") then
                model.variant = normName(line:sub(9))
            else
                table.insert(model.tokens, line)
            end
        end

        if model.name ~= "" then table.insert(library, model) end
    end

    return library
end


--[[ MATCHING (mirrors tools/check_bag.py) ]]--

local function tokenFound(token, entry)
    local t = normWeapon(token)
    for _, weapon in ipairs(entry.weapons) do
        if normWeapon(weapon) == t then return true end
    end
    -- wargear that only shows up in the model name: "Insidiant w/ denuncia"
    return entry.normName:find(normName(token), 1, true) ~= nil
end

local function candidates(entry, unitName, library)
    local exact, family = {}, {}

    for _, model in ipairs(library) do
        if model.unit == nil or model.unit == unitName then
            local isExact, isFamily = false, false
            for _, name in ipairs(model.names) do
                if name == entry.normName then isExact = true
                elseif familyMatches(name, entry.normName) then isFamily = true end
            end
            if isExact then table.insert(exact, model)
            elseif isFamily then table.insert(family, model) end
        end
    end

    -- an exactly named model beats a family match ("Canoness with Jump Pack" vs plain "Canoness")
    return #exact > 0 and exact or family
end

local function match(entry, unitName, library)
    local cands = candidates(entry, unitName, library)
    if #cands == 0 then return { status = "none", models = {}, found = 0 } end

    local scored, perfect, bestFound = {}, {}, -1
    for _, model in ipairs(cands) do
        local found = 0
        for _, token in ipairs(model.tokens) do
            if tokenFound(token, entry) then found = found + 1 end
        end
        local missing = #model.tokens - found
        table.insert(scored, { model = model, score = found - missing })

        if missing == 0 then
            if found > bestFound then perfect, bestFound = { model }, found
            elseif found == bestFound then table.insert(perfect, model) end
        end
    end
    if #perfect > 0 then return { status = "exact", models = perfect, found = bestFound } end

    local fallbacks = {}
    for _, model in ipairs(cands) do
        if model.fallback then table.insert(fallbacks, model) end
    end
    if #fallbacks > 0 then return { status = "fallback", models = fallbacks, found = 0 } end

    local best, approx = nil, {}
    for _, s in ipairs(scored) do
        if best == nil or s.score > best then best, approx = s.score, { s.model }
        elseif s.score == best then table.insert(approx, s.model) end
    end
    return { status = "approx", models = approx, found = 0 }
end

-- Matches all entries of one unit, keeping the whole unit in one variant (paint scheme).
-- Models without a variant fit any. Returns the per-entry results and the chosen variant.
local function matchUnit(unitName, entries, library)
    local variants, seen = {}, {}
    for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
        for _, model in ipairs(candidates(entry, unitName, library)) do
            if model.variant and not seen[model.variant] then
                seen[model.variant] = true
                table.insert(variants, model.variant)
            end
        end
    end

    local results = {}
    if #variants == 0 then
        for i, entry in ipairs(entries) do results[i] = match(entry, unitName, library) end
        return results, nil
    end

    local byVariant, chosen, bestScore, bestFound = {}, {}, -1, -1
    for _, variant in ipairs(variants) do
        local subset = {}
        for _, model in ipairs(library) do
            if model.variant == nil or model.variant == variant then table.insert(subset, model) end
        end

        local res, score, found = {}, 0, 0
        for i, entry in ipairs(entries) do
            res[i] = match(entry, unitName, subset)
            score = score + RANK[res[i].status]
            found = found + res[i].found
        end
        byVariant[variant] = res

        if score > bestScore or (score == bestScore and found > bestFound) then
            chosen, bestScore, bestFound = { variant }, score, found
        elseif score == bestScore and found == bestFound then
            table.insert(chosen, variant)
        end
    end

    local variant = chosen[math.random(#chosen)]
    for i, entry in ipairs(entries) do
        local r = byVariant[variant][i]
        -- an entry the chosen colour cannot fill at all may still use any colour
        results[i] = r.status ~= "none" and r or match(entry, unitName, library)
    end
    return results, variant
end


--[[ MODEL DATA AND SIZES ]]--

local function deepCopy(value)
    if type(value) ~= "table" then return value end
    local copy = {}
    for k, v in pairs(value) do copy[k] = deepCopy(v) end
    return copy
end

local function cleanCopy(data)
    local copy = deepCopy(data)
    copy.States = nil
    copy.LuaScript = ""
    copy.LuaScriptState = ""
    copy.XmlUI = ""
    return copy
end

local function plainVector(v)
    return { x = v.x, y = v.y, z = v.z }
end

local function saveState()
    -- onSave covers saved games and Save Object; this also covers objects copied right away
    pcall(function() self.script_state = JSON.encode(boundsCache) end)
end

-- Spawns every model of the bag that has no size yet (all of them with `all`), locked and out of
-- the way above the bag, INDEX_BATCH at a time, measures it and removes it again.
function indexModels(all)
    if busy then
        broadcastToAll("The bag is busy, wait a few seconds", GREY)
        return
    end
    if all then boundsCache = {} end

    local queue, queued = {}, {}
    for _, data in ipairs(self.getData().ContainedObjects or {}) do
        local key = modelSignature(data)
        if boundsCache[key] == nil and not queued[key] then
            queued[key] = true
            table.insert(queue, { key = key, data = data, name = data.Nickname or "?" })
        end
    end
    if #queue == 0 then
        broadcastToAll("All models in the bag are already indexed", GREEN)
        return
    end

    busy = true
    local measured, failed = 0, {}
    broadcastToAll("Indexing " .. #queue .. " model(s)...", GREY)

    local function finishAll()
        busy = false
        saveState()
        local text = "Indexed " .. measured .. " model(s)"
        if #failed > 0 then
            text = text .. "; " .. #failed .. " did not load and will use the base size: " .. table.concat(failed, ", ")
        end
        broadcastToAll(text .. ". Save the bag (right-click -> Save Object) to keep it.", #failed > 0 and ORANGE or GREEN)
    end

    local function runBatch(first)
        local last = math.min(first + INDEX_BATCH - 1, #queue)
        local pending, batchOver = last - first + 1, false
        local origin = self.getPosition()

        local function batchDone()
            if batchOver then return end
            batchOver = true
            if last < #queue then
                broadcastToAll("Indexed " .. last .. "/" .. #queue, GREY)
                runBatch(last + 1)
            else
                finishAll()
            end
        end
        -- a model whose spawn never calls back must not stall the whole index
        Wait.time(batchDone, INDEX_TIMEOUT + 10)

        for i = first, last do
            local item, slot = queue[i], i - first
            local copy = cleanCopy(item.data)
            copy.Locked = true

            spawnObjectData({
                data = copy,
                position = { origin.x + (slot % 5) * 6 - 12, origin.y + MEASURE_HEIGHT, origin.z + math.floor(slot / 5) * 6 },
                rotation = { 0, 180, 0 },
                callback_function = function(obj)
                    local function finish(loaded)
                        if obj ~= nil then -- destroyed objects compare equal to nil in TTS
                            if loaded and not batchOver then
                                local b = obj.getBoundsNormalized()
                                boundsCache[item.key] = { center = plainVector(b.center), size = plainVector(b.size), offset = plainVector(b.offset) }
                                measured = measured + 1
                            end
                            obj.destruct()
                        end
                        if not loaded or obj == nil then table.insert(failed, item.name) end
                        pending = pending - 1
                        if pending == 0 then batchDone() end
                    end
                    Wait.condition(function() finish(true) end,
                        function() return obj == nil or not obj.loading_custom end,
                        INDEX_TIMEOUT, function() finish(false) end)
                end,
            })
        end
    end

    runBatch(1)
end


--[[ AUTO-ASSIGN ]]--

local function loadoutText(entry)
    local parts, seen = {}, {}
    for _, weapon in ipairs(entry.weapons) do
        local n = normWeapon(weapon)
        if not STANDARD_GEAR[n] and not seen[n] then
            seen[n] = true
            table.insert(parts, trim((weapon:gsub("➤", ""):gsub("%s+%-%s+.*$", ""))))
        end
    end
    return #parts > 0 and (" (" .. table.concat(parts, ", ") .. ")") or ""
end

local function modelNames(models)
    local names, seen = {}, {}
    for _, model in ipairs(models) do
        local label = model.name .. (model.variant and (" [" .. model.variant .. "]") or "")
        if not seen[label] then
            seen[label] = true
            table.insert(names, label)
        end
    end
    return table.concat(names, " / ")
end

-- size from the roster's base (mm), for models not indexed yet
local function baseBounds(entry)
    local base = entry.base or {}
    local x, z = (base.w or 32) / 25.4, (base.h or base.w or 32) / 25.4
    return { center = { x = 0, y = 0, z = 0 }, size = { x = x, y = 1.8, z = z }, offset = { x = 0, y = 0, z = 0 } }
end

local function applyPlan(machine, plan, manual)
    local counts = { exact = 0, fallback = 0, approx = 0, none = 0 }
    local notes, assignments, unindexed = {}, {}, {}

    for _, step in ipairs(plan) do
        local entry, result = step.entry, step.result
        counts[result.status] = counts[result.status] + 1

        -- "none" still goes out: it clears what a previous AUTO run may have assigned
        local assignment = { unit = entry.unitID, model = entry.modelID }
        if result.status ~= "none" then
            local datas, bounds = {}, nil
            for _, libModel in ipairs(result.models) do
                local data = cleanCopy(libModel.data)
                -- Yellowscribe looks this GUID up to highlight the "picked" model; the bag stands in
                data.GUID = self.getGUID()
                table.insert(datas, data)

                -- several candidates may differ in size: lay the unit out for the largest
                local b = boundsCache[libModel.key]
                if b == nil then
                    unindexed[libModel.key] = true
                    b = baseBounds(entry)
                end
                if bounds == nil then
                    bounds = deepCopy(b)
                else
                    bounds.size.x = math.max(bounds.size.x, b.size.x)
                    bounds.size.z = math.max(bounds.size.z, b.size.z)
                end
            end
            assignment.models, assignment.bounds = datas, bounds
        end
        table.insert(assignments, assignment)
        UI.setAttribute(entry.unitID .. "|" .. entry.modelID, "color", CARD_COLORS[result.status])

        local where = step.unitName .. " › " .. entry.name .. loadoutText(entry)
        if result.status == "fallback" then
            table.insert(notes, { step.unitName, ORANGE, "[fallback] " .. where .. " → " .. modelNames(result.models) })
        elseif result.status == "approx" then
            table.insert(notes, { step.unitName, ORANGE, "[closest] " .. where .. " → " .. modelNames(result.models) })
        elseif result.status == "none" then
            table.insert(notes, { step.unitName, RED, "[no model] " .. where .. " - assign it manually" })
        end
    end

    machine.call("sistersAutoAssign", { json = JSON.encode(assignments) })

    table.sort(notes, function(a, b) return a[1] == b[1] and a[3] < b[3] or a[1] < b[1] end)
    for _, note in ipairs(notes) do printToAll(note[3], note[2]) end

    local summary = "AUTO: " .. counts.exact .. " exact, " .. counts.fallback .. " fallback, "
        .. counts.approx .. " closest, " .. counts.none .. " without a model"
    if manual > 0 then summary = summary .. ", " .. manual .. " assigned manually before" end
    broadcastToAll(summary .. ". Check the cards and press CREATE ARMY.", counts.none > 0 and ORANGE or GREEN)

    local missing = 0
    for _ in pairs(unindexed) do missing = missing + 1 end
    if missing > 0 then
        printToAll(missing .. " model(s) are not indexed yet and use the base size. "
            .. "Right-click the bag -> Index new models, then save the bag.", GREY)
    end
end

-- Adds the current HOOK_CODE to the Yellow Machine (replacing older hooks) and restarts it.
local function installHook(machine)
    local script = machine.getLuaScript()
    for _, old in ipairs(OLD_HOOKS) do
        local s, e = script:find(old, 1, true)
        if s then script = script:sub(1, s - 1) .. script:sub(e + 1) end
    end
    local hookStart = script:find("\n-- [Sisters Auto-Assign hook v", 1, true)
    if hookStart then
        local _, hookEnd = script:find(HOOK_END .. "\n", hookStart, true)
        if hookEnd then script = script:sub(1, hookStart - 1) .. script:sub(hookEnd + 1) end
    end

    local _, anchorEnd = script:find(HOOK_ANCHOR, 1, true)
    if anchorEnd then
        -- ForceOrg: `army` is local, so the hook has to sit right after its declaration
        local lineEnd = script:find("\n", anchorEnd, true) or #script
        script = script:sub(1, lineEnd) .. HOOK_CODE .. script:sub(lineEnd + 1)
    else
        -- original Yellowscribe: `army` is global, the top of the script works
        script = HOOK_CODE .. script
    end

    machine.setLuaScript(script)
    machine.reload()
end

function autoAssign(_, playerColor)
    if busy then
        broadcastToAll("The bag is busy indexing, wait a few seconds", GREY)
        return
    end

    local machine = getObjectFromGUID(YELLOW_MACHINE_GUID)
    if machine == nil then
        broadcastToAll("Yellow Machine not found on the table", RED)
        return
    end

    if not machine.getLuaScript():find(HOOK_BEGIN, 1, true) then
        installHook(machine)
        broadcastToAll("Yellow Machine prepared for AUTO (once per table). "
            .. "Press Reset, load the army again and press AUTO once more.", ORANGE)
        return
    end

    local json = machine.call("sistersAutoGetArmy")
    local units = json and JSON.decode(json) or {}
    if #units == 0 then
        broadcastToAll("Load an army in the Yellow Machine first: code -> Submit -> Accept", RED)
        return
    end

    local library = loadLibrary()
    if #library == 0 then
        broadcastToAll("The bag is empty", RED)
        return
    end

    local plan, manual = {}, 0
    for _, unit in ipairs(units) do
        local entries = {}
        for _, model in ipairs(unit.models) do
            if model.manual then
                manual = manual + 1 -- picked by hand in Yellowscribe: leave it alone
            else
                table.insert(entries, {
                    unitID = unit.id,
                    modelID = model.id,
                    name = model.name,
                    normName = normName(model.name),
                    weapons = model.weapons or {},
                    base = model.base,
                })
            end
        end

        local results, variant = matchUnit(normName(unit.name), entries, library)
        local unitName = unit.name .. (variant and (" [" .. variant .. "]") or "")
        for i, entry in ipairs(entries) do
            table.insert(plan, { entry = entry, result = results[i], unitName = unitName })
        end
    end

    local ok, err = pcall(applyPlan, machine, plan, manual)
    if not ok then broadcastToAll("AUTO failed: " .. tostring(err), RED) end
end


--[[ TTS EVENTS ]]--

-- Sizes saved by older versions of this script were keyed "<guid>@<scaleX>"; move them to the
-- mesh signature so the models already measured in this bag do not need indexing again.
local function migrateOldCache()
    local cache = {}
    for key, bounds in pairs(boundsCache) do
        if key:find("|", 1, true) then cache[key] = bounds end
    end
    for _, data in ipairs(self.getData().ContainedObjects or {}) do
        local t = data.Transform or {}
        local old = boundsCache[(data.GUID or "?") .. "@" .. tostring(t.scaleX or 1)]
        local key = modelSignature(data)
        if old ~= nil and cache[key] == nil then cache[key] = old end
    end
    boundsCache = cache
end

function onLoad(state)
    if state ~= nil and state ~= "" then
        local ok, decoded = pcall(JSON.decode, state)
        if ok and type(decoded) == "table" then boundsCache = decoded end
    end
    migrateOldCache()

    self.createButton({
        label = "AUTO",
        tooltip = "Assign models from this bag to the army loaded in the Yellow Machine",
        click_function = "autoAssign",
        function_owner = self,
        position = { 0, 3.5, 0 }, -- lower than ~3 hides it inside the bag mesh
        width = 900,
        height = 400,
        font_size = 260,
        color = { 0.95, 0.8, 0.1 },
        font_color = { 0, 0, 0 },
    })
    self.addContextMenuItem("Auto-assign army", function(playerColor) autoAssign(self, playerColor) end)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Index new models", function() indexModels(false) end)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Re-index all models", function() indexModels(true) end)
end

function onSave()
    return JSON.encode(boundsCache)
end
